profile_text.body:
WeRide Inc. describes itself as a leading, commercial-stage global company developing autonomous driving technologies from Level 2 to Level 4. Its site highlights the WeRide One universal autonomous driving technology platform, a self-developed foundational toolchain, and what it calls an industry-leading accumulation of real-world operational data. The company says its business footprint spans more than 60 cities across 13 countries, and it presents a portfolio of five core products, including Robotaxi.

WeRide is listed on Nasdaq under the ticker WRD and on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange under 0800. The company notes recognition in Fortune's 2025 Change the World and 2025 Future 50 lists. It is a public company with SEC CIK 0001867729 and headquarters listed as Guanzhou. No additional products, litigation, or MCP servers are listed for WeRide.
